examples: The balloon went up.
Look up at the sky.
I climbed up the hill.

more.def: Toward a higher place or position, or out of bed or a lying position.
examples: The smoke rose up from the campfire.
Please stand up when the principal comes in.
I woke up early to watch the sunrise.
The cat sat upon the mat.
Once upon a time there was a king.
A bird landed upon the roof.

more.def: On, or on top of, especially in stories and formal speech.
examples: A crown was set upon the queen's head.
Once upon a time, a dragon lived in a cave.
A bird landed upon the old fence.
I was upset when I lost my toy.
The baby is upset and crying.
Do not be upset. We can fix it.

more.def: Unhappy, worried, or angry about something.
examples: She was upset that her best friend was moving away.
He was upset about losing the game.
The upset customer asked to speak to the manager.
My room is upstairs.
Go upstairs.
She ran upstairs.

more.def: To or on a higher floor of a building.
examples: The bedrooms are upstairs.
Dad carried the laundry upstairs.
Wait upstairs until I call you.
